decisions.statement: A page taken away has the uncommitted files beside it taken away as well.
Which files sit beside a page is read from the page rather than from the folder.
The page read is the one whose own file the change takes away.
A path that is no page has nothing swept beside it.
Only a file whose name says the file is uncommitted is swept.
A file the change already names is swept by nothing.
A file the tree holds no body at is swept by nothing.
A change taking no page away reads no page.
A page a move carries off is swept by nothing.

definition: the uncommitted files beside a page, gone with the page rather than left behind
